credit.notes: SBI Cards managed by SBI Card (separate subsidiary). Also via SBI Card app: Block Card. NRI: +91-40-6717-7777.

debit.notes: YONO app: Cards > Block. SMS BLOCK <Last4> to 56767 from registered mobile. ATM hotlist option available.

upi.notes: UPI FAQ (Disable/Re-enable): a) BHIM SBI Pay (Disabling): "Log in BHIM SBI Pay > hamburger menu > Disable UPI Services > Select Account"; b) Contact Centre: "call on 1800 1234/1800 2100" with registered mobile no/account no; c) "visit any nearest SBI branch" (BHIM SBI Pay FAQ: "stop the facility by contacting your home branch and giving a written request"). Lost phone: "Immediately you need to disable the UPI services by contacting SBI contact center or by approaching nearest any SBI branch." De-register VPA: BHIM SBI Pay app "main menu and use the De-Register option to de-register the UPI facility". UPI also runs on YONO SBI (YONO Pay UPI); complaints via crcf.sbi.co.in, support.upi@sbi.co.in, or toll-free 1800112211 / 18004253800. No netbanking UPI manage path and no USSD/SMS keyword published on official pages.
